answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Eager to Help first while I still had Spark, then Rapid Fire, Kaboom! targeting Nibbit, and Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered leaving the second energy unspent after Eager to Help so it could be used on one of the drawn cards, but their identities are not given, so I chose the guaranteed 5 Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the flexibility to spend the second energy on a card drawn by Eager to Help.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit had not telegraphed damage, I would have omitted Duck and Cover and retained the second energy for the cards drawn by Eager to Help.
